instruction: Perform one bounded, read-only engineering assessment of the exact local alexwelcing/lupine-rhizo revision. This is a holistic repository assessment, not a LAMMPS-first pilot. The orchestrator should accept this explicit operator task and assign exactly one worker. Use at most 16 total model turns across the orchestrator and worker; plan the inspection to leave calls for a ready report. First read AGENTS.md and README.md, then use a bounded tracked-tree listing and selected source reads to map eight domains: durable agent orchestration and ownership; discovery and knowledge graph; Library publication and provenance; numerical/scientific compute including LAMMPS and interatomic-potential workflows; formal proofs and evidence gates; build, dependencies and deployment; evaluation and operational measurement; and researcher-facing UX and taxonomy. Every domain conclusion must cite a concrete inspected path and distinguish source-observed behavior from proposed improvements and unavailable runtime evidence. Inspect representative high-value files rather than claiming the entire repository was read. Identify the three most consequential cross-system risks or opportunities, connect each to the existing canonical control plane, and propose a precise failure/recovery test for each. Do not invent benchmark scores, scientific accuracy, independent validation or completed runtime tests. Do not modify tracked source, install packages, call external models, access credentials, deploy, publish, send messages, start recurring work, or execute simulations/training. Native read/bash are available in the dedicated coding guest; use short bounded commands, explicit timeoutMs at most 30000, and no background processes. Write two deliverables with native bash: .lupine-coding-evidence/repository-assessment.md, at most 2000 words, and .lupine-coding-evidence/repository-assessment.json with exact git revision, inspectedPaths, eight domain findings, top three priorities with acceptance tests, exclusions and limitations. Keep each deliverable below 64 KiB. Then use orchestrator_report with state ready and a concise truthful summary containing the deliverable paths. A report is engineering evidence for review, not scientific acceptance or publication approval. The local result channel is only an internal sink; do not claim external delivery.
